title: End-to-End Supervised Learning System
description: Build a supervised learning system with reproducible evaluation: dataset documentation, leakage-free train/validation/test splits, at least three model families under identical preprocessing, fixed random seeds, a metrics report, and a CLI that reproduces every number in the README from a clean checkout.
learningObjectives: Compare model families with identical preprocessing and splits
Report confusion matrix, ROC/PR-AUC, calibration, and baseline comparisons
Reproduce every reported metric from a single command and seed

deliverables.title: Evaluation report
deliverables.description: Metrics tables and charts with seeds recorded.

milestones.title: Dataset ingestion & splits
milestones.objective: Load a public dataset, document its license, and produce deterministic train/val/test splits with a fixed seed.
milestones.expectedOutput: Data module that outputs identical splits given the same seed and hash.

milestones.title: Three model families
milestones.objective: Train at least three families (linear, tree ensemble, simple MLP) under identical preprocessing.
milestones.expectedOutput: Model registry with saved artifacts and configs.

milestones.title: Evaluation & baselines
milestones.objective: Evaluate with accuracy, ROC-AUC/PR-AUC, calibration curves, and a trivial-baseline beat check.

milestones.title: Reproducible CLI
milestones.objective: One documented command chain reproduces every README metric from a clean clone.
milestones.expectedOutput: CI or documented commands matching README numbers to stated precision.

categories.minimumExpectation: Honest val/test separation with documented metric definitions
categories.excellentExpectation: Leakage test that re-derives splits and detects contamination

categories.minimumExpectation: Fixed seeds and repeated runs documented
README numbers reproduced by a reviewer
categories.excellentExpectation: CI recomputes metrics on every commit
End-to-end integration test on a tiny dataset
Pipeline verified by unit tests at each stage

architecture: Config-driven with one YAML per experiment
constraints: No metric reported without a code path producing it
hints: Include a majority-class baseline; a model that barely beats it is a finding, not a failure

requiredEvidence.description: Repository with data, models, evaluation, and CLI.
Metrics report (or in-repo path) with seeds and splits documented.
CI link or test output showing the pipeline tests passing.
